name: Candy Cane
asset_text: A candy cane fishing rod: a red and white striped shaft that curls into a hook at the tip, with a gold star hanging from the hook. A dark green velvet grip with a gold end cap and a big red ribbon bow. A red and gold spinning reel hangs under the rod above the grip, with a small gold jingle bell on its crank. Matches the reference image's design.
